  RootPackage
  typealias Octet = UInt8
  fun patternInt8(value: Int8): Int
    =
      WhenExpression
        Var value
        arm -128
          IntLiteral 1
        else
          IntLiteral 0
  fun patternInt16(value: Int16): Int
    =
      WhenExpression
        Var value
        arm 32767
          IntLiteral 1
        else
          IntLiteral 0
  fun patternInt(value: Int): Int
    =
      WhenExpression
        Var value
        arm 2147483647
          IntLiteral 1
        else
          IntLiteral 0
  fun patternLong(value: Long): Int
    =
      WhenExpression
        Var value
        arm 9223372036854775807L
          IntLiteral 1
        else
          IntLiteral 0
  fun patternUInt8(value: UInt8): Int
    =
      WhenExpression
        Var value
        arm 255u
          IntLiteral 1
        else
          IntLiteral 0
  fun patternUInt16(value: UInt16): Int
    =
      WhenExpression
        Var value
        arm 65535u
          IntLiteral 1
        else
          IntLiteral 0
  fun patternUInt(value: UInt): Int
    =
      WhenExpression
        Var value
        arm 4294967295u
          IntLiteral 1
        else
          IntLiteral 0
  fun patternULong(value: ULong): Int
    =
      WhenExpression
        Var value
        arm 18446744073709551615uL
          IntLiteral 1
        else
          IntLiteral 0
    @NoGC
  fun combinedEquality(value: Octet): Boolean
    =
      WhenExpression
        Var value
        arm -1u
          Binary Ne
            Var value
            IntLiteral 0u
        else
          Binary Eq
            MethodCall inc
              Var value
            IntLiteral 2u
  fun nestedPattern(value: (Int, Int8)): Int
    =
      WhenExpression
        Var value
        arm (1, 2)
          IntLiteral 1
        else
          IntLiteral 0
